paragraphs: He transmits teachings in the name of Rav in [Gittin 62a](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.62a.11) and [Menachot 90a](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.90a.13).[^1]

notes.text: Gittin concerns interactions with non-Jews in the Sabbatical year. Menachot concerns whether a service vessel sanctifies its contents without intent.
